🔥Fire in the #Philippines Destroys Over 50 Homes.

A major fire erupted Sunday evening in a residential area of Barangay Commonwealth, #Quezon City. 

The blaze destroyed more than 50 homes and affected approximately 100 families, prompting emergency response teams to assist those displaced.
